Git history shows that by commit e9a85998, ProcedureRequestStatus was already bound required to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-status.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest is retired from the current build: source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active and approved and comments ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest. Commit 06bd9f6f renamed ProcedureRequest source to ServiceRequest, so ServiceRequest is the current successor artifact to inspect.
